description.narrative: 2 I 2. Establishment of preconditions for national and subnational employment governance

comment.narrative: The sample of Ugandas latest dedicated labour force survey covers approximately 5355 household biannually. A National Employment Strategy NES does not exist but a National Employment Policy dated April 2011.

Labour Force Survey key indicators disaggregated by subnational level and major economic sectors are accessible in the public domain www and NES approved including its implementation plan ME framework and mediumterm funding requirements for national and local employment governance.

title.narrative: 1 I 2. Status of service delivery standards for Local government

description.narrative: 1 I 2. Status of service delivery standards for Local government

comment.narrative: The Local Government Act obliges line ministries to establish minimum national standards for service delivery in the sectors under their jurisdiction. Approved minimum service delivery standards for local governments do not exist. A Medium Term Expenditure Framework for the achievement of service delivery targets for local governments does not exist.

Costed medium term service delivery targets for local governments approved and accessible in the public domain for the following sectors health education social development production and marketing water and environment works and transport public administration and management services
The Ministry of PublicServices and the NationalPlanning Authority undertook substantial efforts todeliver the target butwithout attaining it.
